Tranquilo leader of Los Ingobernables de Japón.

How Tetsuya Naito connects

  • Faction: Los Ingobernables de Japón — Naito leads Los Ingobernables de Japón.
  • Item: IWGP World Heavyweight Championship — Naito won the IWGP World Heavyweight Championship as LIJ's destrozando Ace.

What is Tetsuya Naito?

Tetsuya Naito turned from failed Ace into the LIJ destrozando-star who chased, then won, the IWGP Heavyweight and Intercontinental double, and later the IWGP World Heavyweight Championship.

Key threads lead to Los Ingobernables de Japón and IWGP World Heavyweight Championship.
